content: Firestore transactions vs batches (firebase.google.com/docs/firestore/manage-data/transactions + quotas): transactions = reads-then-writes, atomic, retried on conflict, FAIL when client is offline; batched writes = writes-only, atomic, no retries, EXECUTE even when device is offline (queued in local cache, synced later) — the right primitive for the account-deletion cascade. Batch ceiling: official delete-collections doc states deleting a collection of more than 500 documents requires multiple batched write operations; docs also warn hundreds of docs per batch can exceed transaction size; max API request size 10 MiB; 270s transaction time limit. Consequence: cascade delete must chunk deletes into batches of <=500 docs (loop query->batch-delete until none remain). Rules: getAfter() can validate atomic writes; access-call limits 10 per op / 20 per batch.
